notes.title: Update Notes for Sticker Delight v1.32 - November 2024
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Everyone,[/h3]

We're excited to bring you updates for Sticker Delight!

[h3]What's new in version 1.32:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added [b]resize & rotate stickers functionality[/b] in the Sticker Book. Happy crafting!
[*] Added [b]Steam Achievements[/b] (it took us some time to figure this out!)
[*] Added [b]more symbol stickers[/b] (@#&,.:'-) to generate in the Sticker Book 
[*] Increased the resolution of downloaded Sticker Book
[/list]
We hope you enjoy the new update! 😊

notes.title: Recap: After Releasing Sticker Delight Last Month 🥁
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Everyone,[/h3]
We hope you're all doing well! ✨
We're excited to bring you some updates, after releasing Sticker Delight last month!

[h3](1) Sticker Delight has been reviewed "Positive"![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077900/e1529d138a35d36ca9614b24e7c81fb65020a842.jpg[/img]
What can we say except thank you! It’s all thanks to awesome people like you who trust Sticker Delight, play it, and share your thoughts in reviews. We read every single one, and they mean the world to us! Nothing makes us happier than seeing you enjoy cozy, nostalgic moments with Sticker Delight. We’re always looking for ways to make the game even better, so keep those reviews coming!

We just love reading your feedback—so don’t hesitate to share your thoughts after playing! 😊

[h3](2) Sticker Delight started to make appearances [/h3]
We were thrilled to see Sticker Delight made appearances across Southeast Asia's media, as well as within indie & cozy game communities on various platforms. Check out the coverage here:
[list]
[*] SEA Game Dev Collective Digest - [url=https://seagamedevdigest.substack.com/p/sea-game-dev-collective-digest-september]September Edition[/url]
[*] VirtualSEA - on both their [url=https://virtualseasia.com/category/releases/page/2/?_release_year=2024&_release_month=iseptember]website[/url] and [url=https://youtu.be/LVK0OZQdzxM?si=v_yZdnS0D5_2dWMv&t=90]Youtube Channel[/url]
[*] The Magic Rain - [url=https://themagicrain.com/2024/09/heres-every-sea-game-awards-finalist-from-level-up-kl-2024/]Here’s Every SEA Game Awards Finalist From Level Up KL 2024[/url]
[*] Livestream by [url=https://www.twitch.tv/nuryem]nuryEm on Twitch[/url] (and [url=https://x.com/nuryem_/status/1834945370062741508]their craft made on stream[/url]) 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077900/7025a5be202fe43929533c812338366bc2da09a8.png[/img]
[*] [url=https://x.com/SEAGamethetic/status/1836025384917426444]South East Asia Game Aesthetic[/url]
[/list]
A big thank you to each community for the support and for helping share Sticker Delight with the world!

[h3](3) Sticker Delight showcase at Level Up KL 2024[/h3]
Sticker Delight was featured in the SEA Game Award Finalists 2024 zone at Level Up KL on October 2-3, 2024. We loved seeing visitors enjoy playing and crafting with the stickers, with some even purchasing the game on the spot!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077900/d0c66ccc7ed2fbf5e992a69e29f633f660ad7274.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077900/29270b88694414c4f694807432e0bad5d63fd1c8.jpg[/img]

[h3](4) Sticker Delight's next update[/h3]
After reading your reviews and watching players enjoy Sticker Delight, we're excited to share a sneak peek of what's coming next!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077900/46faea831b0740b6271632188cb623ffbaebf04f.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] We're currently working on an update to enhance the Sticker Book, which will allow you to resize and rotate the stickers.
[*] Also, we're going to add Steam Achievements.
[/list]
Stay tuned for the updates!

[h3](5) Dawn Sky's newsletter sign up[/h3]
We want to stay connected with players who love Sticker Delight. Working on and releasing Sticker Delight has given us the confidence that there are players out there (like you!) who appreciate games that fit into your lives.

If you love Sticker Delight and would like to receive special updates straight to your inbox, please [url=https://preview.mailerlite.io/preview/1126097/sites/134014956488099103/dawnsky]sign up for our newsletter using this link[/url]. 



Now back to the game,
[b]Li
Producer - Sticker Delight[/b]
[url=https://linktr.ee/stickerdelight]Dawn Sky's Socials[/url]

notes.title: Update Notes for v1.31 (20th of September 2024)
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

Thank you for playing Sticker Delight! We are thrilled to see you enjoying and reviewing the game.
Some players have reached out to us about issues they encountered, so we're releasing a patch!

What's improved in version 1.31:
[list]
[*] Adjusted the area inside the Sticker Book to make interactions more convenient
[*] The Chili Crab finally appears on the dinner table
[*] Optimized screen resolution to accommodate ultra-wide displays
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the new update! 😊

notes.title: Sticker Delight Update #3: Introducing Sticker Book in The Game
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Everyone,[/h3]

We have two exciting updates to share this time! ✨

[h3]Introducing: Sticker Book Feature[/h3]
We have finally finished developing a delightful new feature for the game:[b] the Sticker Book[/b]. You will be able to access the Sticker Book after completing dinner for the first time. Inside the Sticker Book, you can:
[list]
[*] Reminisce about the memories by keeping photos taken during dinner
[*] Choose and keep your favorite stickers from the pack
[*] Express yourself using stickers from the pack and text stickers that you create (we've also included a screenshot and download button, so you can share it with your loved ones)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077900/4aeb991592017a8cd4766767b4408c62167bb12c.gif[/img]

While this might not be obvious, we also believe that the Sticker Book is a versatile tool that you can keep coming back to in the future to express your thoughts to loved ones!
It works like this: Open the Sticker Book → express your thoughts → screenshot and download → share it to your loved ones → repeat

[h3]Sticker Delight is Nominated as SEA Game Awards 2024 Finalist![/h3] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077900/9a09554312d218d5a15ea9b9441ec2bde738efe6.png[/img]
Earlier this month, we received an announcement that Sticker Delight has been nominated for the SEA Game Awards 2024 ([url=https://fb.watch/up9qflwQKM/]public announcement here[/url])! The final results will be announced on October 2, and we're sharing this joy to spread positive energy to everyone following our news 😊

I'll catch you in the next post,
[b]Li
Producer - Sticker Delight[/b]

notes.title: Rebrand Announcement: Sticker Delight
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone,[/h3]

I'd like to announce that we are rebranding [b]"My Dinner Table"[/b] into [b]"Sticker Delight"[/b]! ✨
Don't worry, we will maintain the same game experience while adding delightful new feature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077900/c52ee215288c6ccd2e96cf2f76b648bbba45e318.png[/img]

To share a little bit more, we are rebranding to ensure the title and assets best represent the game experience we are working on.

We hope you love the new identity - [b]Sticker Delight[/b] - as much as we do! 🥳 


Catch you in the next post,
[b]Li 
Producer - Sticker Delight[/b]
